questions.stem: A memo for district 39 notes a mountain range blocks moist air; explain the rainfall shadow on the far side.

answer.exemplar: Moist air rises and cools on the windward side, dropping rain, so the leeward side lies in a dry rainfall shadow with little precipitation.
